# Load data from supp.xlsx, "Chemo " sheet (note the space after Chemo in the sheet name)

matches = re.search(r"retrospective clinical follow-up from (\d+) patients", patient_cohort_text)
n_patients = int(matches.group(1)) if matches else None
# Check the accuracy claim: 5 correct for 6 good responders, 2 correct for 3 rapid progressors, 1 incorrect → total 8/9 = 0.8888888889
correct_matches = re.search(r"Of the (\d+) patients with a progression-free survival.* (\d+) were treated with at least one drug.* no drug to which.*resistant.* (\d+) of the (\d+) patients who rapidly progressed were treated with a chemotherapeutic agent to which their PDO was markedly resistant.* One of the nine patients exhibited an outcome inconsistent", patient_cohort_text)
if correct_matches:
    n_good = int(correct_matches.group(1))
    n_good_correct = int(correct_matches.group(2))
    n_poor = int(correct_matches.group(4))
    n_poor_correct = int(correct_matches.group(3))
    total_correct = n_good_correct + n_poor_correct
    computed_accuracy = total_correct / n_patients
else:
    computed_accuracy = None

# Define fields
fields = {
    "unit": {"value": "patient", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "Each record is a single advanced PDAC patient with matched PDO and clinical outcome"},

    "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "PDO sensitivity is evaluated for the same chemotherapeutic agents the patient received"},
    "n_units": {"value": n_patients, "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "9 advanced PDAC patients included in the retrospective concordance analysis"},
    "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p13"], "explanation": "The 9 patients are a subset of the full 66 PDO cohort; no independent held-out split was used for this small retrospective analysis"}
